name: Kathleen Rastetter
occupation: Justice of the Peace, Clackamas County

bio.statement: A county news release says Governor Tina Kotek appointed Rastetter Justice of the Peace at the Clackamas County Justice Court, effective January 1, 2026.
bio.excerpt: Governor Tina Kotek appointed Kathleen J. Rastetter to serve as Justice of the Peace

bio.statement: Rastetter's pamphlet statement lists service as a justice of the peace pro tem, senior attorney for Clackamas County, and partner at Cosgrave Vergeer Kester.
bio.excerpt: Justice of the Peace Pro Tem; Senior Attorney Clackamas County; Partner, Cosgrave Vergeer Kester law firm

bio.statement: Rastetter's pamphlet statement lists a law degree (J.D.) from Rutgers Law School with Order of the Coif.
bio.excerpt: Rutgers Law School, Law, Juris Doctor; Order of the Coif;

bio.statement: Rastetter's pamphlet statement lists service on the Oregon State Bar Disciplinary Board.
bio.excerpt: Justice Court Pro Tem; Oregon State Bar Disciplinary Board

bio.statement: Rastetter's pamphlet statement says she has over thirty years of legal experience in civil, employment, appellate and tax law.
bio.excerpt: I have over thirty years of legal experience practicing civil, employment, appellate and tax law.

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Rastetter says she strives to apply the law fairly and impartially while treating everyone with dignity and respect.
positions.excerpt: I strive to fairly and impartially apply the law while treating everyone with dignity and respect.

gaps: Judicial candidate: no policy positions beyond judicial approach
